definitions.gloss: Yamatai; an ancient state ruled by Queen Himiko
definitions.explanation: A state of the Wa (Japanese) people in the 3rd century, known mainly from a Chinese chronicle of the Wei dynasty, which says Queen Himiko ruled it and sent envoys to the Wei court.

examples.japanese: {邪馬台国|やまたいこく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧にあった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{邪馬台国|やまたいこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{女王|じょおう}→女王：03349_joou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{卑弥呼|ひみこ}→卑弥呼：31978_himiko⟧だ。

examples.english: Whether Yamatai was in Kyushu or in the Kinki region is still debated.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
- Its location is one of the best-known debates in Japanese history: the Kinki theory ({畿内説|きないせつ}, often tied to the Makimuku site in Nara) against the Kyushu theory ({九州説|きゅうしゅうせつ})
- The main written source is the Chinese chronicle {魏志倭人伝|ぎしわじんでん}

PRONUNCIATION:
- Some scholars read it やまとこく, but やまたい⟦こく→コク：20672_koku⟧ is the reading taught in schools
